analysis.reason: RSI 43.1에서 50.8로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 339.0414에서 1511.8284로 개선되며 상승 전환 신호 강화. 5일 저가 96,700원 대비 20일 저가 82,500원 높아진 Higher Low 패턴 형성. 4거래일 연속 상승세로 거래량은 위축되었으나, 추세 전환 지표들이 긍정적 신호 발현.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 43.1 to 50.8, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from 339.0414 to 1511.8284, strengthening the bullish reversal signal. A Higher Low pattern formed with the 5-day low at 96,700 KRW and the 20-day low at 82,500 KRW. Despite subdued volume with four consecutive days of gains, trend-indicating indicators are showing positive signs.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉은 ADX 39.4로 뚜렷한 추세이나, 일봉상 RSI 50.8로 중립 구간 진입, MACD 개선으로 단기 상승 전환 신호 강화.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly chart shows a clear trend with ADX at 39.4, but the daily chart shows RSI at 50.8 entering neutral territory and MACD improvement, strengthening short-term bullish reversal signals.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (108,190 KRW) vs SMA5 (101,544 KRW)/SMA20 (102,464 KRW)/SMA50 (119,302 KRW) — positioned near the middle of short-to-mid-term trends, above SMA5/20, below SMA50
· Position vs SMA100 (110,697 KRW)/SMA200 (88,966 KRW) — below SMA100 for mid-to-long-term trend, above SMA200
· 52-week position (59.9%) + current price level historically mid-range
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.1→50.8) — confirmed exit from oversold, entering neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (339.0414→1511.8284) — improving, strengthening bullish reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 102,464 KRW) — sideways near the middle band, band width at 25.52% indicates moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (82,500 KRW) — based on Pivot S1 (88,773 KRW) and 20-day low
· Swing resistance level (126,170 KRW) — below R2 (134,477 KRW) and 52-week high (152,560 KRW)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — confirmed recovery signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.58x) — contracted compared to 5-day average, indicating moderate confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — RSI exiting oversold and MACD improving, with a Higher Low pattern confirmed, suggesting consideration for entry
